question: A convex mirror used as a rear-view mirror has a radius of curvature of $3$ m. A bus is $5$ m behind it. The image is at

options.text: $1.5$ m in front of the mirror
$\dfrac{15}{13}$ m in front of the mirror

solution: $f = +1.5$ m, $u = -5$ m: $\dfrac{1}{v} = \dfrac{1}{1.5} + \dfrac{1}{5} = \dfrac{13}{15}$, so $v = \dfrac{15}{13} \approx 1.15$ m behind the mirror (virtual, erect, diminished).
